notes.subject: פרחח
notes.rationale: Lentšu le le tlageha fela mo go Tanakh — 'sehlaha', bana ba batho ba batla ba le fashe.

notes.subject: ויסלו
notes.rationale: 'ba bopeletša' (cast up, ASV/JPS — go aga mmušo wa go lwantšha) kgahlanong le 'ba tsea maoto' (push away, KJV) — bothata bja modu.

notes.subject: שלחו ... שלחו
notes.rationale: פסוק 11 le 12 ka bobedi di fedile ka שלחו — go lahlwa ga renthane le go lahlwa ga maoto, sebopego seo se pholilego ka Sepedi.

translation: Ka letsogong la go ja la ka sehlaha se ema, ba lahla ⟨את⟩ maoto a ka, gomme ba bopeletša kgahlanong le nna ditsela tša masetlapelo a tšona.

tokens.gloss: letsogong la go ja la ka
